quote: We've had a pretty stark retracement from above $74,000 down to about 71.5K. I don't really think there's too much to worry about. This was a bit of a healthy pullback. We have some spot beneath us. I wouldn't consider scaling in here until we got to around 71 to 72K. Coming down quite nicely into a big cluster of volume support coinciding with this technical level of around $70,000.
